reason: The V5 primary score scale changed materially across annual refits. Feeding that score back into the loss model would couple the risk layer to the same unstable calibration and requires row-aligned 2023 primary OOF inputs.
risk_model_inputs: Frozen V5 compact direction-normalized M1 microstructure features
primary_gate_unchanged: The original V5 primary gate still determines which target-year proposals are eligible before loss-risk pruning.
